onboarding.body: Ekkies connects to your bank and shows you exactly what you spend — calm, clear, without judgment.
onboarding.prop_1: Connect your bank in under a minute
onboarding.prop_3: Money until payday — always on your lock screen

connect.headline:
Connect
your bank.
connect.body: We connect securely via open banking standard (PSD2). We never see your password or account details.
connect.security_note: Bank connection powered by Tink — the same standard all EU banks use.

payday.headline:
When do
you get paid?
payday.body: We use this to show how much you have left until your next payday. You can change this at any time.
payday.preview: You get paid on the {{day}}th every month

home.insight_text: You've spent the most on food this month. Keep an eye on it!

insights.title: Insights
insights.subtitle:
Calm observations about your money.
No judgment here.
insights.i1_text: You spent 18% more on food this week compared to last. Mostly grocery and cafés.
insights.i2_text: You've stayed under your transport budget three weeks in a row. That's 340 kr extra in your pocket.
insights.i3_text: You're paying for 4 streaming services. That's 567 kr/month. Are you using all of them?
insights.i4_text: You spend on average 42% more in the first week after payday. Pretty normal — but good to know.
